checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Dog consistent with dog.jpg in all three
must.why: Beach is near-identical to the original. Snow is clearly the same dog but slightly leaner, with a more upright stance. Living room is the same dog but the pose and angle differ and the face looks a bit different.

must.item: Locations visibly beach, snowy forest trail, cosy living room
must.why: Each setting is clear and matches its prompt.

must.item: Dog naturally integrated with plausible scale, lighting, ground contact
must.why: Beach and living room are good. Snow has a slightly stiff, stretched-looking standing pose and the legs look a little thin, but it is acceptable.

faults.what: Beach image reuses the original pose and framing, so it looks like a background swap with the dog pasted in. The dog looks slightly flat against the scene.
Snow image: the dog is leaner and the front-facing stance is stiff, with slightly odd legs and paws.
Living room image: the dog's muzzle and face look slightly different (darker nose, different head angle) and the body is longer. The identity is still plausible.

summary: Three convincing square photos of what looks like the same golden retriever in the right settings, with only minor identity drift in the snow and living room shots.
